    AI Overview
    Jared Polis
     (D) is the 43rd and current governor of Colorado, in office since January 2019. A former tech entrepreneur and U.S. Representative, Polis is known as a "western libertarian" Democrat focusing on cost of living, renewable energy, and education. He is currently serving his final term due to term limits. 
    Key Details About Governor Polis: 
    • Political Focus: Polis identifies as "pro-freedom," supporting education, green energy initiatives, and economic opportunity.
    • Accomplishments: His administration expanded free full-day kindergarten, pushed for 100% renewable energy by 2040, and implemented significant healthcare cost reductions
      .
    • Recent Agenda (2026): His final year priorities include increasing affordable housing, reducing income taxes, and lowering property/car insurance rates.
    • Background: An entrepreneur who founded companies like ProFlowers and Techstars before entering politics. 
    He works with Lieutenant Governor Dianne Primavera, who focuses on health initiatives.

    Colorado Governor Jared Polis is a
    Democrat. First elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, he is currently serving his final term and is known for being a "libertarian Democrat" who focuses on economic growth, healthcare affordability, and personal freedom. 
    • Political Affiliation: Democrat
    • Key Focus Areas: He has championed universal preschool, legalized psychedelics, and implemented tax cuts, while also supporting policies such as stricter gun laws.
    • Background: Before becoming governor, he was a member of the U.S. House of Representatives. 
    He is currently term-limited and will be replaced following the 2026 election
    .
